newsitem.title: USA: Florida police major arrested for resisiting arrest.
newsitem.headline: Florida police major arrested for resisiting arrest.

text.p: A Florida police major has been charged with battery and resisting arrest with violence after he was pulled over for a traffic violation, police said Friday.
Aaron Campbell was booked at the Orange County Jail after the incident Wednesday night and has since posted bail.

Campbell, district commander of the Carol City substation, was stopped by a deputy sherrif as he was travelling on the Florida turnpike. Police video showed him arguing and swearing at the officers then apparently trying to run away.
He has been suspended with pay.
